messages:
maria_cs: Hello all — kicking off onboarding for NorthStar Health (FlightPath). Objective: sandbox up + two production-ish flows (patient triage + note summarization) in 30 days, pilot adoption signal by day 60.

maria_cs: Need to lock owners for infra, enablement, renewal watch, and feedback so I can send invites.

dan_csm: I'll handle renewals & commercial. Heads-up: legal has a tight SLA review window — flagging this as a potential renewal risk (monitor milestone at day 21). :warning:  

priya_se: I'll own integration & infra prep. Plan: get VPC access day 1-3, run embeddings smoke test day 5, end-to-end triage test by day 14.

leo_customer_pm: Confirming success metrics from product side:
- Pilot NPS >= 70
- 95th pct generation latency < 350ms in sandbox
- Intent precision for triage > 95% (FP <5%)
- 80% of pilot users perform 3+ sessions/week
If we hit these, we recommend go/no-go for production rollout.

jenna_onboard: I'll run the enablement curriculum and own feedback capture. Proposed quick cadence: Day 0 orientation (30m), Day 3 infra handoff (45m), Day 7 deep-dive (1h), then weekly 30m checkpoints. Can we do Day 0 tomorrow 9am PT?

maria_cs: Tomorrow 9am PT works for NorthStar. Please add calendar invites after owners confirmed.

priya_se: Infra notes: NorthStar is private VPC + strict egress. Short checklist I'll use: 
```
- VPC CIDR + peering details
- Inbound ports & customer firewall rules
- Service account provisioning + IAM roles
- KMS key ARN + access window
- Test model: quant-small-v2
```
I'll DM the secure doc and paste the checklist here.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: infra-handoff at 1748620600 (Day 3)

dan_csm: Renewal watch triggers I'll track: legal delay >14 days, <10 active pilot users by day 30, 3+ reliability incidents, or no exec sponsor check-in in first 21 days. Escalation: AM + RevOps + CSM lead.

jenna_onboard: Feedback capture plan: post-session Google Form (3 questions), weekly in-product micro-survey (1 question), and a short slack pulse for engaged users. I'll own collection + weekly summary.

leo_customer_pm: I'll supply pilot user roster and data access matrix by EOD. Also want one internal QA session between day 10-12.

maria_cs: Owner map (reply with :thumbsup: to confirm):
- CSM / Program lead: maria_cs
- Renewals & Commercial: dan_csm
- Integration / Infra: priya_se
- Product / Pilot success: leo_customer_pm
- Enablement / Feedback: jenna_onboard

priya_se: :thumbsup: confirmed. I'll upload the VPC checklist and a required-ports snippet.

leo_customer_pm: :thumbsup: roster in progress.

d an_csm: :thumbsup: (typo in channel name but confirming)

jenna_onboard: :thumbsup: enablement agenda + form created, will share link post-orientation.

maria_cs: Action items recap: 
- maria_cs: send calendar invites + initial success doc (today)
- priya_se: VPC checklist + smoke test model (EOD)
- jenna_onboard: enablement decks + survey (EOD)
- dan_csm: renewal watch SOP + escalation path (48h)
- leo_customer_pm: pilot roster + QA window (EOD)

maria_cs: Any blockers? If none, I'll close this thread after invites go out. Thanks! :rocket:
